annotations.title: What is happening in the city right now

description: Live alerts in a city, deduplicated from official feeds (roads, transit, weather, power, water, construction) and placed by the app's own rule into four buckets: now (live and current), ongoing (live for more than two days, or unconfirmed), ahead (starts later, within 7 days, grouped by day) and recap (ended in the last 12 hours). Each item carries a stable signal_id. Use this for any 'what is going on in <city>' or 'anything I should know before I head out' question. Events and games are in city_events. Items with a real picture carry picture_url. Images in the result are visible to the assistant only: give the person picture_url as a tappable markdown link next to the item. Never say an image is shown. Show only CitySignal pictures for an incident (picture_url, gallery_url, placeholder_url): never add images from the web or any other source, not even as illustrations. In apps that show CitySignal cards natively, the cards appear on their own; still add one line per card.

category.description: Only this category: road, transit, weather, power, water, construction, emergency, film, sanitation, government_notice. Omit for all.
